bundle.shortDescription: MPN Studio: visual workbench for Modular Persistent Networks
bundle.longDescription: MPN Studio is the Fylume workbench for Yaob modular persistent networks (MPN). Edit nodes, cells and relations on a visual whiteboard, keep projects on your computer, and work fully offline. Optional remote compute can be connected separately.
